research_status: Read research rounds in the current Slack thread, including plans, status and revisions. Read this
before proposing or controlling research. Follow nextOffset to find older rounds; latestId always
identifies the newest round in the thread. This does not change a plan or execution.
research_propose: Create a research plan or update a draft using its id and revision. Include unresolved questions
only when necessary. Use parentId for a new round following a completed report. This prepares a plan
for user confirmation and does not start research.
research_control: Control a research round using the id and revision returned by research_status. Start only after the
user confirms an existing plan in a later message. Resume continues an interrupted round. Pause
stops execution, cancel abandons an unfinished round while retaining saved materials, finish requests
a final report, and canvas exports a completed result. Pausing a Canvas export preserves the completed round.
Refresh restores the status message and its buttons without changing the research plan or execution.
research_result: Read the final or latest stage report for a research round in the current thread. Follow nextOffset
to read additional chunks. Reports are model outputs, not independently verified evidence.
